briefing.headline: xAI and OpenAI push AGI timelines forward amid escalating model releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as frontier labs release advanced models weekly. Compute constraints and safety concerns dominate strategic discussions. Global investment remains robust despite regulatory scrutiny.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI unveiled Grok-4 with enhanced multi-agent capabilities. OpenAI's o4-preview demonstrates unprecedented reasoning depth. DeepSeek and Meta continue open-source competition with rapid iterations.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to major hyperscalers. Google and Microsoft expand data center capacity in the US and Middle East with new chip architectures.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium before 2028?
